design: Three source-disjoint current MSSR documents, one frozen query per document, real Jev exact-range selection, exact fetch/fingerprint validation, and one evidence pack per selected handle. A separate provider-off union and host paragraph may be composed only from selected validated handles.

priorExposure.residual: Indirect exposure through summaries, conversations, or non-identical excerpts cannot be ruled out.

questions.bridgeSemanticOwnership: What role does Bridge have relative to MSSR routing and other hosts?
questions.noticeAuthorityContract: What bounded fields and allowed/forbidden actions define a notice?
questions.recommendationCorrection: What exact change returned skill_recommend to deterministic route planning?

primaryMetrics: expected target present in deterministic search results
Jev selected the exact accepted range
exact fetch and current fingerprint validation
union retention of only selected validated ranges
raw Choice/evidence-sufficiency and token usage, descriptive only
independentUnit: Three distinct current MSSR documents, one query per document; source-cluster count is descriptive and does not establish statistical independence.

minimumSupport.interpretation: Reporting floor; three document-disjoint exploratory cases do not meet it.

uncertaintyMethod: Raw counts only; no inferential claim, no threshold tuning, and no calibration.
unionPolicy: Use only handles selected by Jev and exact-fetch/fingerprint validated. If any case is missing or invalid, report the union as incomplete and do not substitute an expected range.

blindReview.input: Anonymized queries, exact selected text, citations, union and host paragraph; omit labels, source identifiers, scores, and statuses.
